create_object_editor: create an ObjectEditor instance from a habitat_sim.Simulator to manage interactive object editing in the scene
move_selected_objects: move all selected objects by a translation vector or rotation quaternion using move_sel_objects
remove_and_restore_objects: remove selected objects from the scene with remove_sel_objects or restore them with restore_removed_objects
undo_redo_edits: undo or redo transformation edits on selected objects using undo_sel_edits and redo_sel_edits
duplicate_and_build_objects: duplicate selected objects or load new objects by handle substring using build_objects
